section_summary.extract_value: This section presents descriptive statistics (Table 1) and path analysis results for a single study (N = 155; 44 men, 111 women). The study examined relationships among external shame (OAS), self-compassion (SCS_SC), body appreciation (BAS-2), and BMI using self-report measures. Path analysis revealed that external shame had direct negative effects on both self-compassion and body appreciation, with self-compassion mediating the relationship between external shame and body appreciation. A multigroup analysis confirmed the model's invariance across gender groups.
